decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall not commence later than the expiration of 3 years beginning with the date of this planning permission.

Condition required to be imposed by section 91(1)(a) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended by section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004).

Condition : 3 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out and completed in accordance with the materials details (including colour and finish) specified below:

Walls: Yellow London stock brick to match the existing building in terms of brick and mortar colour and bond pattern.  

Roof extensions: Natural or artificial grey/black slate tiles which shall match the colour, shape and size of the existing roof.

Dormers face/cheeks: Slate to match existing roof. 

Windows: Timber frame.
 
Doors: Timber frame. 

The development shall be permanently retained in accordance with the approved details. 

To ensure a satisfactory external appearance, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC4 and DC8 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 4 - The terrace hereby approved shall not be first used until the privacy screening has been installed [as shown on approved Dwg Nos. 006 Rev C, 007 Rev C and 008  Rev A]. 

The privacy screen shall achieve a minimum level of obscurity equivalent 
to Pilkington Texture Glass Level 3 and shall have a height of 1.7m above the finished floor level of the terrace along the north rear elevation. 

The privacy screen shall thereafter be permanently retained as approved.   

To protect the amenities of neighbouring occupiers in terms of overlooking and privacy in accordance with Policy HO11 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 5 - No part of any roof of the front and rear roof extensions hereby approved shall be used as a roof terrace or other form of open amenity space. No alterations shall be carried out; nor planters or other chattels placed on the roof. No railings or other means of enclosure shall be erected on the roofs, and no alterations shall be carried out to the property to form access onto the roofs.  

The use of the roofs as a terrace would increase the likelihood of harm to the existing residential amenities of the occupiers of neighbouring properties as a result of overlooking, noise and disturbance, contrary to Policies HO11 and CC11 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 6 - No water tanks, water tank enclosures or other structures (excluding solar panels and air source heat pumps) shall be erected upon the roofs of the extensions 
hereby permitted. 

It is considered that such structures would seriously detract from the appearance of the building, contrary to Policies DC4 and DC8 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 7 - Prior to the occupation of the development hereby permitted, the windows at upper ground and first floor levels in the east elevation [as shown on Dwg No.008 Rev A]  shall be fitted with obscure glass to a minimum level of obscurity equivalent to Pilkington Texture Glass Level 3. The first floor sash window on particular and shall be non-opening and fixed shut up to a height of 1.7m above the finished floor level. 

The windows shall thereafter be permanently retained as approved. 

To protect the amenities of adjoining occupiers in terms of privacy and overlooking in accordance with Policy HO11 of the Local Plan (2018).
description: Part retrospective application for the erection of a front dormer roof extension, erection of a rear roof extension, a first floor rear extension above the existing back addition, together with the widening of the back addition structure, the formation of a roof terrace with associated privacy screening, re-sizing of existing openings on rear elevation and the installation of new windows to the side elevation, as well as repositioning of the main front entrance door.
